title: extension.host@1
description: What a manifest declares about the host process its piece runs (#104), beside extension.manifest@1, whose frozen shape doesn't list it: what the host process runs, how long it lives and what it owns. A piece that hosts terminals runs any command you could, so it also asks for the run_as_you access word, which you approve on the trusted path.
